notice: Maintenance configuration; documented source terms are not human approval or permission to publish candidates.

gbif.specialty: Global checklist aggregation, scoped external IDs and descendant discovery; not independent confirmation of upstream sources.
gbif.licensing: Read dataset license and citation from the registry API. Never transfer a dataset license to a photograph.
gbif.access: Public read-only API, serial requests spaced by at least 1.1 seconds; bounded queries, cache, no occurrence or location endpoints.

worms.specialty: Marine nomenclature, accepted AphiaIDs, synonyms and source citations.
worms.licensing: CC BY text with individual exceptions; version is not inferred. Images default to NC-SA and are not imported. Whole-database redistribution requires prior agreement.
worms.access: Small exact-name lookups and accepted-ID resolution only; no full-database replica or gallery downloads.

col.specialty: Versioned global checklist, original-source links, identifiers and differing classifications.
col.licensing: Read release metadata. The value 'cc by' without a version remains incomplete. XR combines automated additions and upstream sources; it is not an independent expert review of each result.
col.access: Public ChecklistBank lookup; pin release key, DOI and version. Dataset 316165 is the tested August 2026 XR snapshot, not a rolling latest release. Custom downloads can require an account.

commons.specialty: Candidate media with file-specific author and license evidence; search does not establish organism identity or photographic authenticity.
commons.licensing: Reuse exploration_media.license_from: CC0 or CC BY with a verifiable version/URL, author credit and no restrictions. No image bytes are downloaded by candidate discovery.
commons.access: Serial API requests, maxlag=5, descriptive User-Agent, no retry on 429.

ncbi.specialty: TaxIDs, names and sequence-associated taxonomy, particularly microbes and Archaea; not a universal nomenclatural authority.
ncbi.plan: Next adapter: ESearch/EFetch or Datasets API, preserve TaxID, synonyms versus in-part/equivalent names and unranked lineage. Require maintainer contact/tool configuration and display NCBI disclaimer. Retain old IDs/merged/deleted states; no sequences or personal data.
ncbi.licensing: No blanket CC0 assumption. Government and third-party material have different conditions. Record record-specific rights and consult copyright disclaimer before offline incorporation.
ncbi.access: E-utilities <=3 requests/second without a key; this project defaults to <=1/1.1 seconds. No contact address invented; large jobs subject to NCBI scheduling guidance.

lpsn.specialty: Prokaryotic nomenclature and standing under the relevant nomenclatural code; separate from genome phylogeny.
lpsn.plan: Official API or permitted downloads after access configuration; preserve name status, type strain references and citation. Never scrape taxon HTML pages automatically.
lpsn.licensing: CC BY-SA 4.0; attribution, specific-page links and access date required. Decide/document share-alike treatment or obtain compatible permission before offline redistribution.

powo.specialty: Plant names, IPNI identifiers, accepted names and botanical distribution evidence.
powo.plan: Confirm a supported API or official versioned WCVP dataset and automated-access terms. Preserve IPNI LSIDs and original links. Distribution, text and media require separate rights and evidence.
powo.licensing: Use the individual dataset metadata; Kew site terms and image credits are not a universal license for descriptions or photographs.

mycobank.specialty: Fungal nomenclatural identifiers, original publications and name registration; registration does not by itself establish a phylogenetic position.
mycobank.plan: Official site exposed no readable API/redistribution terms during this investigation. Confirm documented webservice/export and permissions with the source before enabling an adapter; no undocumented scraping.
mycobank.licensing: Unverified. No license or authorization presumed; offline incorporation blocked pending evidence.
